gaps.explanation: The governmental funds statement (p5, GAAP/modified accrual) vs the budgetary comparison schedules (pp12-16, budgetary basis, 'Total resources'). General Fund statement total revenues 23,633,151 vs budget schedule 23,538,696 (p12) = 94,455; Street 4,956,813 vs 4,941,399 (p14) = 15,414; Museum 1,904,042 vs 1,899,546 (p15) = 4,496; Debt Service 784,481 vs 781,382 (p16) = 3,099; Other Governmental Funds 8,288,287 = nonmajor combining statement columns (pp17-20) 8,288,287, no difference. 94,455 + 15,414 + 4,496 + 3,099 = 117,464 = the gap. Detail lines sum to each printed schedule total, so nothing is missing or duplicated; the printed totals differ by basis. No fix.

Statement (p5, GAAP) vs budgetary comparison schedules (budgetary basis, 'Total charges to appropriations'): General Fund 21,019,724 vs 21,194,419 (pp12-13) = -174,695; Street 3,907,915 vs 3,850,325 (p14) = 57,590; Museum 1,636,555 vs 1,654,480 (p15) = -17,925; Debt Service 465,750 vs 466,697 (p16) = -947; Other Governmental Funds 6,261,772 = nonmajor combining statement (pp17-20) 6,261,772. -174,695 + 57,590 - 17,925 - 947 = -135,977 = the gap. Basis difference only; no fix.
